name: Half Level
description: Halve the input amplitude to leave headroom for mixing.

name: Unity
description: Pass the input at its original amplitude.

name: Quarter Level
description: Reduce amplitude to one quarter for dense parallel layers.

name: Quiet Bed
description: A low 0.12 gain for supporting harmonics and textures.

name: Subtle Layer
description: Attenuate a very quiet layer without changing its waveform.

name: Modulation Center
description: Begin at 0.65 gain; use a bipolar modulation cable for movement.
